title: A Big Party
setting: A bright community hall with decorations and long tables of food.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi, a young boy with dark skin, short hair and a red shirt

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Max
characters.look: Max, a tall man with glasses and a blue sweater

sentences.en: Kofi and his cousin Hana arrive together.
sentences.zh: 科菲和他的表妹哈娜一起到达。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with dark skin, short hair and a red shirt and Hana, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt walk hand in hand toward a bright community hall.

sentences.en: Max welcomes them at the door with a smile.
sentences.zh: 马克斯在门口笑着欢迎他们。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, a tall man with glasses and a blue sweater opens the hall door and smiles at Kofi, a young boy with dark skin, short hair and a red shirt and Hana, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt.

sentences.en: Many people from different countries are inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多来自不同国家的人。
sentences.scene_prompt: A busy decorated community hall full of people of many different backgrounds talking.

sentences.en: Two Chinese women make dumplings at a table.
sentences.zh: 两位中国女士在桌边包饺子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Two Chinese women in a decorated hall fold dumplings together at a long table.

sentences.en: Max was born in a small German town.
sentences.zh: 马克斯出生在德国的一个小镇。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, a tall man with glasses and a blue sweater shows Kofi, a young boy with dark skin, short hair and a red shirt and Hana, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt a photo of a small old German town with a church.

sentences.en: Each parent brings a famous dish from their country.
sentences.zh: 每位家长都带来一道自己国家的名菜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mothers and fathers put many colourful dishes on a long table in the hall.

sentences.en: Hana has an idea: a big dance for everyone.
sentences.zh: 哈娜有个主意：大家一起跳个大舞。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt raises her hand with a bright smile next to Kofi, a young boy with dark skin, short hair and a red shirt.

sentences.en: Every person in the room joins the dance.
sentences.zh: 房间里的每个人都加入了舞蹈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with dark skin, short hair and a red shirt, Hana, a young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt, Max, a tall man with glasses and a blue sweater and all the people in the hall dance together in a big circle.
